code:
MESSY: "this looks bad, escalating" -- no note, no evidence
  -> Tier 2 re-validates from scratch, slower than if Tier 1
     had just finished the job

CLEAN: ticket + case note + evidence + reason attached
  -> Tier 2 starts their part immediately, nothing redone
caption: Escalating is handing off work Tier 2 needs to finish -- not handing off Tier 1's unfinished homework.
